people.name: Elnathan
people.line: A royal official during the reign of King Jehoiakim.

people.name: Gemariah
people.line: Son of Shaphan; official during Jehoiakim's reign; opposed burning scroll.

translations.web: Moreover Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the scroll; but he would not listen to them.
translations.bsb: Even though Elnathan, Delaiah, and Gemariah urged the king not to burn the scroll, he would not listen to them.
